shortBio.en: AC/DC vocalist 1974–80; Highway to Hell-era bark. Death forces the Johnson-era reboot.
shortBio.zh: AC/DC 主唱 1974–80；Highway to Hell 时期的吠叫。去世迫使 Johnson 时期重启。

whyHub.en: Singer-leaves case: catalog peak with Scott, then equal-scale peak with Johnson on the same guitar method.
whyHub.zh: 主唱离开案例：Scott 时期目录巅峰，随后 Johnson 在同一吉他方法上达到同等尺度巅峰。

body.en:
Joined 1974. Nasal, shouted leads over open-chord riffs. Dies 1980 after Highway to Hell.

Person page exists so Bon-era and Johnson-era AC/DC stay comparable seasons, not a purity fight.
body.zh:
1974 年加入。鼻音喊叫主音架在开放和弦 riff 上。Highway to Hell 后于 1980 年去世。

人物页用来让 Bon 时期与 Johnson 时期成为可比较的赛季，而不是纯度战争。
